text: Implemented store-independent create-only ObjectWriter and AsyncObjectWriter capabilities; deterministic SyncZarrWriter and AsyncZarrWriter for arrays and groups; metadata-last completion with typed incomplete progress; prefix-safe default/v2 keys; direct and start/end indexed-shard writing; all 11 fixed-width carriers, transpose, CRC32C, JVM/browser gzip, and external codec providers; portable constant-memory SHA-256 content receipts; async backpressure; and a JVM hard-link object creator plus atomic staged-directory adapter. Evidence: zarrJVM/test 126/126 and zarrJS/test 136/136; archive-zarr JVM 11/11 and JS 8/8; dataset-zarr JVM 7/7 and JS 3/3; optional Blosc provider JVM 10/10 and JS 10/10; compileAll green; separate published-artifact consumer compiled on JVM and JS; Zarr-Python 3.2.1 read Scala outputs for every fixed-width dtype, rank-five gzip/CRC, uint64, v2-key transpose, and indexed sharding; Scala read the reciprocal Python fixtures. No overwrite, append, resize, rollback claim, filesystem dependency, or neuroimaging policy entered the shared core.
